exposure: high uterine artery Doppler pulsatile index (PI)
Healthy term pregnancy vs. IUGR pregnancy vs. IUGR with preeclampsia
Normal uterine artery PI vs. high uterine artery PI
outcome: interstitial and endovascular extravillous trophoblast (EVT) invasion
expression of progesterone receptor isoform B, IGFBP-1, and CD10 in DSCs
cohort: Pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean delivery or second-trimester termination
finding: Pregnancies complicated by severe IUGR with a high uterine artery PI showed a lack of myometrial vascular transformation and EVT invasion, lower maternal leukocytes, increased apoptotic EVT, and impaired decidualization with a less favorable immune profile.
